title: Worksheet 9: Input and Output Devices (V2.0)
directions: Read the paragraph below carefully. Then answer all questions using ONLY the information in the paragraph. Circle the letter of the best answer.
paragraph: Computers interact with the world through input and output devices. An input device is any piece of hardware used to send information or commands into a computer. Common input devices include a keyboard (used to type text), a mouse (used to click and point), a microphone (used to record sound), and a scanner (used to digitize paper documents). An output device, on the other hand, displays or produces information that comes out of the computer for a person to see, hear, or use. Common output devices include a monitor (which displays images), speakers (which play sound), and a printer (which produces paper copies of documents). Some devices, like touchscreens, act as both input and output devices at the same time, since they display information (output) and also respond to touch (input).

questions.text: According to the paragraph, an input device is used to:
questions.correct: Send information or commands into a computer
distractors: Display information coming out of a computer

questions.text: A student uses a microphone to record a voice command, and the computer answers through speakers. Based on the paragraph, how would you classify these two devices?
questions.correct: The microphone is input and the speakers are output
distractors: The microphone is output and the speakers are input
